summary: A triangle's cells now stop on the project's own calendar diagonal, so cells past the valuation date can no longer be typed into.
details: A new or cleared hand-entered triangle asks the project where its diagonal falls instead of dropping one column a row, which was only ever right when the origin and development lengths matched.
An annual triangle shown at a quarterly development now drops four columns a row and stops at the valuation date rather than at the last development header.
A figure an older file holds past the diagonal is no longer shown or editable, and the next save writes that cell blank. Vectors keep every cell.
